rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1: Human Capital
rows.snippet: The Company believes that its people play an important role in its success... As of September 27, 2025, the Company had approximately 166,000 full-time equivalent employees.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1A: Risk Factors - Data Privacy and AI
rows.snippet: The risks of inadvertent disclosure of personal data can increase with the introduction of new and complex technologies, such as artificial intelligence features, further exacerbating such risks.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Risk Factors - Data Privacy and Security
rows.snippet: We are subject to stringent and changing data privacy and security laws, rules, regulations and other obligations. These areas could damage our reputation, deter current and potential customers, affect our product design, or result in legal or regulatory proceedings and liability.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Business Overview - AI-First Strategy
rows.snippet: It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Culture and Workforce
rows.snippet: As of December 31, 2025, Alphabet had 190,820 employees.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Making AI Helpful for Everyone
rows.snippet: We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Privacy and Security
rows.snippet: We make it a priority to protect the privacy and security of our products, users, and customers, even if there are near-term financial consequences.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1: Human Capital - Career Choice Reskilling
rows.snippet: Over 300,000 Amazon employees around the world have participated in Career Choice.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 7: MD&A - Severance / Role Elimination Charges
rows.snippet: Operating income for 2025 includes charges of $2.5 billion we recorded in Q3 2025 related to the settlement of a lawsuit with the FTC and $2.7 billion, of which $1.8 billion was recorded in Q3 2025, of estimated severance costs primarily related to planned role eliminations.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Note 7: Commitments and Contingencies - Luxembourg GDPR Fine
rows.snippet: In July 2021, the Luxembourg National Commission for Data Protection (the 'CNPD') issued a decision against Amazon Europe Core S.à r.l. claiming that Amazon's processing of personal data did not comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation. The decision imposes a fine of €746 million and corresponding practice revisions.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital
rows.snippet: We had a global workforce of 78,865 employees as of December 31, 2025.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Employee Learning and Development
rows.snippet: We aim to make AI utilization core to the way we operate by providing our personnel access to AI tools and training programs.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Risk Factors - AI Initiatives
rows.snippet: We have made significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products, enhance our advertising tools, develop new products, and develop new features for existing products.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Legal Proceedings - Privacy Penalties
rows.snippet: We entered into a settlement and modified consent order to resolve the FTC inquiry, which took effect in April 2020 and required us to pay a penalty of $5.0 billion. ... the IDPC issued an administrative fine of EUR €1.2 billion.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital - Employee Base
rows.snippet: As of November 2, 2025, we had approximately 33,000 employees worldwide, with approximately 57% in research and development roles.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Business - AI Infrastructure Demand
rows.snippet: Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions also enable our customers to build and deploy AI data center infrastructure for their training and inference workloads and manage the movement of data across their AI network infrastructure based on open, flexible, standards-based Ethernet.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - Frameworks
rows.snippet: Our program includes processes for identifying, assessing and managing material risks from cybersecurity threats that are guided by the National Institute of Standards & Technology's Cybersecurity Framework, the ISO 27001 international standard for information security and other applicable industry benchmarks.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - Board Oversight
rows.snippet: Our Board of Directors is actively involved in overseeing our cybersecurity risk management and shares oversight responsibility and processes with the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors (the "Audit Committee").

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1A: Risk Factors - AI Human Oversight
rows.snippet: Human review of certain inputs and outputs or other forms of human oversight may be required, including for agentic AI systems that can take actions autonomously.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Note 14: Contingencies - Irish DPC/LinkedIn GDPR Decision
rows.snippet: In 2018, the Irish Data Protection Commission ('IDPC') began investigating a complaint against LinkedIn as to whether LinkedIn's targeted advertising practices violated the recently implemented European Union General Data Protection Regulation ('GDPR'). ... In October 2024, the IDPC provided LinkedIn with a final decision alleging GDPR violations and assessing a fine.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1: Business - AI Skilling Programs
rows.snippet: Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways.

rows.title: Microsoft to cut 4,800 jobs, overhaul Xbox unit
rows.snippet: Microsoft said on Monday it would cut 4,800 jobs, or about 2.1% of its global workforce, overhauling its Xbox gaming unit while shifting investment toward AI infrastructure.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital Management
rows.snippet: As of the end of fiscal year 2026, we had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries; 31,000 were engaged in research and development and 11,000 were engaged in sales, marketing, operations, and administrative positions.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Business Overview - AI Infrastructure
rows.snippet: NVIDIA is now a data center scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital Management - Employee Development
rows.snippet: We invest in employee development through on-the-job trainings and tuition reimbursement programs.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital Resources
rows.snippet: As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Business Overview - Real-World AI Focus
rows.snippet: We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence ("AI") into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving ("FSD") (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots ("Bots") (including Optimus).

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - Risk Management
rows.snippet: To defend, detect and respond to cybersecurity incidents, we, among other things: conduct proactive privacy and cybersecurity reviews of systems and applications, audit applicable data policies, perform penetration testing using external third-party tools and techniques to test security controls, operate a bug bounty program to encourage proactive vulnerability reporting, conduct employee training, monitor emerging laws and regulations related to data protection and information security (including our consumer products) and implement appropriate changes.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - Governance
rows.snippet: Our Audit Committee is responsible for the oversight of risks from cybersecurity threats.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Talent and People
rows.snippet: This year, we grew our total workforce from approximately 31,600 in fiscal 2024 to approximately 34,100 employees in fiscal 2025, an increase of 8% year-over-year.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Talent and People - GenAI Hub
rows.snippet: Visa's commitment to innovation and collaboration is reflected in how we equip employees with GenAI capabilities that can enhance content creation, productivity and business automation.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Risk Factors - Human Oversight of AI
rows.snippet: Human review of certain inputs and outputs or other forms of human oversight may be required, including for agentic AI systems that can take actions autonomously.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Government Regulation - Privacy, Data Use, AI and Cybersecurity
rows.snippet: Aspects of our operations or business are subject to increasingly complex and fragmented data-related regulations, including with respect to privacy, data use, AI and cybersecurity.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital Resources
rows.snippet: As of December 31, 2025, we had more than 390,000 employees, of whom nearly 165,000 were clinical professionals.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Business - Clinical Expertise, Technology and Data
rows.snippet: Bringing together clinical expertise, technology and data to make care simpler, more effective and more affordable, we seek to advance whole-person health.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Risk Factors - AI Systems and Governance
rows.snippet: To the extent an AI system does not operate as intended or produces an inaccurate, incomplete or biased output, the system could impact operations, customer service or other functions and could have an adverse effect on our business.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Risk Factors - Change Healthcare Cyberattack
rows.snippet: We previously reported that our Change Healthcare business, which we had recently acquired, was subject to a cyberattack in 2024, in which the data involved contained protected health information or personally identifiable information.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital Resources
rows.snippet: As of January 31, 2026, we employed approximately 2.1 million associates around the world with approximately 1.6 million associates in the U.S. and approximately 0.5 million associates internationally.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Forward-Looking Statements - AI Investment
rows.snippet: Our increasing investments in eCommerce, technology (including the use of artificial intelligence "AI"), automation, supply chain, new stores and clubs as well as remodels and other omnichannel customer initiatives, such as same day pickup and delivery.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - Governance
rows.snippet: The Audit Committee receives periodic updates from our Chief Information Security Officer ("CISO"), Chief Technology Officer ("CTO") and other members of management on risks related to information systems, information security, data privacy and cybersecurity.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Item 1C Cybersecurity - NIST-CSF
rows.snippet: Our cybersecurity program is informed by various industry frameworks including the National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST-CSF), which are reflected in our related policies, standards, processes and practices.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Human Capital
rows.snippet: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had approximately 104,000 employees, a decrease of 4% versus the prior year due to the ongoing restructuring program.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Focused Portfolio, Supply Chain and Productivity Plan
rows.snippet: These restructuring activities include a plan for a reduction of up to 7,000 non-manufacturing overhead personnel by the end of fiscal 2027.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Strategic Focus - AI and Changing Consumer Habits
rows.snippet: Lastly, technologies, including AI, offer new capabilities to innovate, produce and market our products and brands.

rows.title: Form 10-K, Cybersecurity - Governance
rows.snippet: The Audit Committee also receives regular updates from the Company's CIO and CISO about the Company's information security and systems security programs and plans, including emerging trends and progress on overall enterprise cybersecurity programs and priorities.
